title: Configure one Work Pulse and bounded scheduled sources
query: Configure Farplane V1 automations for Pulse, Feed Scout, Daily, Weekly, and self-improvement.
reference_points: Creates exactly one heartbeat and it invokes pulse-update
Keeps Feed Scout, Daily/Weekly BAU, and Dogfood as cron jobs
Keeps exact reviewable prompts in farplane/automations.toml
Does not add a hidden scheduler, separate check-in loop, or Taste Loop controller
Makes Work Pulse the shared ticket and matured-check-in executor

title: Update the existing live Pulse instead of duplicating it
query: The desired config calls the heartbeat farplane-work-pulse, but the live task already uses farplane-ticket-update on the correct thread. Activate the new config.
reference_points: Inspects the existing live automation before mutation
Updates or deliberately renames the existing heartbeat rather than creating a duplicate
Keeps exactly one active Pulse heartbeat
Aligns tracked config source identity and live prompt
Preserves the existing target thread unless a migration is explicitly required

title: Apply a heartbeat model at the correct live boundary
query: Use Sol with medium reasoning for this existing heartbeat task.
reference_points: Checks whether model selection belongs to the heartbeat automation or its target thread
Uses the supported model identifier and medium reasoning setting
Does not invent unsupported automations.toml fields
Updates the live task or sends a model-overridden continuation when that is the supported boundary
Verifies the next beat rather than claiming the setting changed from tracked config alone
